subject: Gränges AB
status: Candidate comparisons; no peer financials collected or valuation multiple inferred
selection_basis: Aluminium rolling and fabrication, customer mix and recycling economics
Compare metal pass-through, volume and conversion pricing before comparing sales margins
Compare asset intensity, maintenance and growth investment, not domicile alone

candidates.name: Constellium SE
candidates.role: Listed candidate; requires metric and segment matching
candidates.observed_business: Rolled and extruded aluminium for packaging, automotive, aerospace and industry; recycling operations.
candidates.reason: Rolling and recycling offer useful operating comparisons; automotive and packaging overlap supports further review.
candidates.differences: Aerospace plates, structural extrusions and the wider product mix differ from Gränges. Compare relevant segments and metal pass-through before whole-company margins or capital returns.

sources.supports: Current issuer identity and NYSE CSTM listing

candidates.name: UACJ Corporation
candidates.role: Listed candidate; requires metric and segment matching
candidates.observed_business: Flat-rolled aluminium including can stock, automotive heat exchanger and air-conditioner fin materials; also extrusion, components, foil and aerospace/defence materials.
candidates.reason: Heat exchanger and fin products offer a closer product comparison; rolling assets make reinvestment and utilization relevant.
candidates.differences: Broader products and operating geographies require segment matching. Its business profit excludes metal-price lag and other items; do not equate that measure with unadjusted EBIT or assume reported ROIC has the same tax basis.

sources.supports: Issuer and listing, as of 30 September 2026
Business profit adjustment and pre-tax ROIC definition

candidates.name: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation
candidates.role: Listed candidate; requires metric and segment matching
candidates.observed_business: North American fabricated aluminium plate, sheet, coil and extrusions serving aerospace, packaging, general engineering and automotive customers.
candidates.reason: Fabrication, customer qualification and rolling investments offer operating comparisons. Metal-price pass-through and conversion revenue make revenue-denominator matching essential.
candidates.differences: Aerospace/high-strength and extrusion exposure differ from Gränges. Conversion revenue subtracts hedged alloyed-metal cost and is not ordinary reported sales.

sources.supports: Pricing, Metal Price Risk Management, and Hedging; Metal Pricing Policies

candidates.name: Novelis Inc.
candidates.role: Operating reference only; wholly owned Hindalco subsidiary, not a standalone listed equity peer
candidates.observed_business: Global aluminium rolling and recycling serving beverage packaging, automotive, aerospace and specialty markets.
candidates.reason: Rolling, recycling and customer mix offer operating and capital-intensity context.
candidates.differences: Scale, product mix and group financing differ. Do not substitute parent Hindalco's equity multiple for a Novelis standalone multiple.

missing_evidence: No harmonized peer margins, ROIC, cash flow, maintenance capex or current market multiples have been collected. These candidates do not establish a peer median or justify a change to the Gränges exit multiple.
